g.text: 5. Expertise versus headcount on held-out questions
RECORDED RESPONSES | Selection and weights use training questions only. Every method is scored on the same held-out items.
The target is the held-out accuracy of nine random raters from that dataset.
Exact subset scores for all methods; trained weights are discretized nonnegative log odds, not a claim of optimality.
Bird bands condition on fixed training. City split has disjoint city identities and uses complete items; no city confidence bands.
